title: Referrals and Authorizations Extension Limits Table
content:
Whether a **Referrals and Authorizations** type may be extended on the same authorization, and by how much, is fixed per type in this table, together with the basis on which care beyond the authorization is authorized.

| Authorization type | Extensions allowed | Most extensions on one authorization | Units added by one extension | Calendar days the span's last day moves out by one extension | Calendar days after the span's last day an extension request is still accepted | Care beyond the authorization is authorized by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Specialty Care Referral | yes | 1 | 6 | 90 | 0 | a new referral from the PCM |
| Rehabilitative Therapy Referral | yes | 2 | 12 | 45 | 0 | a new referral from the PCM |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | a new authorization for replacement or purchase |
| Home Health Care Authorization | yes | 3 | 30 | 60 | 0 | a new authorization for a new episode |
| Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization | no | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | a new authorization every six months with an updated treatment plan |
| Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization | yes | 6 | 14 | 14 | 0 | a new authorization |
| Inpatient Mental Health Authorization | yes | 10 | 3 | 3 | 0 | a new authorization |

## Reading the table

- A figure of 0 in the acceptance column means the extension request must be received on or before the span's last day itself; this figure is 0 for every type.
- The Durable Medical Equipment Authorization and the Applied Behavior Analysis Authorization take no extensions; their extension figures are all 0.
- The last column names what authorizes further care once an authorization cannot carry it: for the two PCM referral types, a new referral from the PCM; for the inpatient types, a new authorization.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A Rehabilitative Therapy Referral whose span ends on 30 May can be extended at most twice; each extension adds 12 visits and moves the span's last day out by 45 calendar days.
